**Prerequisites & External Dependencies**
List all external packages required (e.g., `lucide-react`, `framer-motion`):

**Checklist Before Submission**
- [ ] Code is free of proprietary secrets, tracking pixels, or telemetry
- [ ] Previews work without crashing the browser or requiring paid API tokens
- [ ] Upstream author license permits redistribution under open-source terms
- [ ] Tested responsive behavior on Mobile (390px) and Desktop (1200px+)
